evals.prompt: Run pr-digest for the active PR on this branch. I want the full digest: title/body vs actual diff, standalone comments, unresolved review threads with outdated ones resolved, and current checks.
evals.expected_output: A structured PR digest report with read coverage, title/body sync classification, development digest, standalone comment triage, open thread triage including outdated-thread resolution counts, check table, and prioritized action list.

evals.prompt: Here is the PR: https://github.com/example-org/example-repo/pull/123. Digest it before I hand it back to reviewers. Pay special attention to whether the description still matches what shipped and whether any review comments are real blockers.
evals.expected_output: A report that resolves the PR URL, fetches PR metadata/diff/comments/threads/checks, flags stale or incomplete PR prose, separates standalone comments from unresolved review threads, reports valid blockers, and lists check failures or pending checks.

evals.prompt: Do a pr digest on this PR, but don't touch code. Clean up outdated GitHub review threads if they are marked outdated, then tell me what's left for the author.
evals.expected_output: A report-only digest that performs no code edits, resolves only GitHub-marked outdated unresolved threads, leaves valid or ambiguous threads open, and returns the remaining author actions with evidence links.
